query:
SELECT
            p.id AS "prompt_id!",
            pv.version AS "version!",
            pv.content AS "content!"
         FROM prompts p
         INNER JOIN prompt_versions pv ON pv.prompt_id = p.id
         WHERE p.slug = $1
           AND pv.stage = 'PRODUCTION'::prompt_stage
         ORDER BY pv.version DESC
         LIMIT 1
